name: STONE_STUDY original kind-2 granite; isolated Kowloon candidate leaf

source.scope: Programme text translation only. No original HTML, scan, GLB, photo or restricted texture is included.

frozenDependency.sharedStruct: KpSurface is supplied once by the existing brick core
frozenDependency.integration: Append KP_GRANITE_WGSL after KP_STONE_WGSL. Do not replace generic kind-0 entry points, id13, or other site stone.

metric.heightConversion: original kind-2 source height * sRelief * 0.026, exactly once
metric.classification: Authored 2 mm nominal grid design, not a measured grain-diameter distribution, sampled Kowloon scan or natural fine-granite calibration
metric.warpCaveat: Original warp distorts local crystal cell spacing. Quoted spacings are unwarped arithmetic lattice spacings.

height.fields: Original q warp, scell(q*13+seed), broad sf(q*1.35+seed), grain valueNoise3(q*49+seed), original pits sf(q*19+poreSeed)
height.warning: Nearest-cell crystal.y has actual jumps at Voronoi boundaries. Faithful arithmetic is not a smooth or conservative distance function. Integration must verify stepping and normals; the material filter does not hide or remove this geometry issue.

pointSurface.sourceExactSemantics: Original kind-2 a/b masks, sRGB palette, region multiplier, mineral and roughness, pits cavity, weather wet response, chroma and srgbToLinear; height shared with kpGraniteHeight
pointSurface.gpuBitParity: Observed identical original GLSL/WGSL linear RGB, roughness and metric height at32 finite GPU points on ANGLE SwiftShader, run38352773172. Not a universal or cross-device proof.

maintenance.publicFunction: kpGraniteSurface(pLocalM, normal, age, wet, repair, physicalFootprintM)
maintenance.bridge: Same resolveStoneFabric bridge as frozen kind-0 leaf
maintenance.geometryEffect: None. Returned height is always the same unfiltered original source point height. Architectural retained-age multiplier, if applied by receiver, is outside this leaf.

filter.classification: New, explicit source-response footprint bridge; source parameter values remain separate and unchanged
filter.normalContract: normal must be in pLocalM coordinates; a zero normal falls back to local +Y
filter.physicalFootprintContract: Nonnegative scalar side length in metres of an isotropic tangent-plane square; negative values clamp to zero
filter.zeroFootprint: Direct kpGraniteOriginalSurface call with the same maintenance uniforms
filter.finiteFootprint: Fixed 2x2 Gauss quadrature on local tangent square at offsets +/- physicalFootprintM/(2*sqrt(3)); average original linear color and roughness responses
filter.warpFootprint: Use edge chord lengths of the same four warped source samples, divided by 1/sqrt(3), and never less than nominal footprint/scaleM. This is a sampled magnification estimate, not a Lipschitz bound or exact anisotropic screen derivative.

mineralBlend.blend: smoothstep sourceFootprint*13; exact crystal responses lose weight continuously, ensemble reaches weight 1 at two cells
mineralBlend.ensemble: Assume original crystal.x hash uniform on [0,1]. Integrate the source response after original sRGB-to-linear, not its palette before conversion.
mineralBlend.quadrature: Exact weights .28 dark, .28 light, .32 fully mixed pink; each .06 smoothstep interval integrated with three Gauss nodes. Nine total scalar mineral taps.

filter.lowFrequency: Retain original q/region/weather fields. Each original sf octave tends continuously to .5 using 1-smoothstep(.35,1,sourceFootprint*octaveFrequency), same weights .57/.28/.15 and offsets 0/13.7/27.2. Unresolved octaves do not inject fresh samples.

poreMean.use: Only unresolved wet/cavity appearance; never original height or geometry
poreMean.limitation: Finite CPU-double ensemble estimate; nearest-cell occupancy, pore-weather dependence and nonlinear wet response correlations are not exactly integrated.

filter.farLimit: No mineral-identity point samples in appearance once meanWeight==1. Original region/weather remains until its own source frequencies are unresolved; fully unresolved appearance is a deterministic ensemble response.
limitations: Four-point quadrature is an approximation and may change discretely where a sample crosses an original crystal boundary before ensemble takeover.
Ensemble prior is not a measured mineral composition nor the exact finite-pixel spatial average.
The statistical octave attenuation and pore mean are declared appearance approximations, not full band-limiting.
Scalar normal-oriented footprint cannot encode anisotropic pixel shape, curvature, visibility or silhouette coverage.
Averaging roughness parameters is not exact integration of the final BRDF.
Original geometry remains full-frequency and discontinuous, with no material-filter claim over its shadow/normal aliasing.

performance.geometryQuery: One original scell search + original height fields; no color/roughness work
performance.pointSurface: One original field evaluation; shares q/crystal/pits between height and appearance
performance.filteredSurface: One exact center height; four same-source warped tangent samples. Up to four appearance scell searches only while mineral point weight is nonzero; zero appearance scell searches in the far statistical branch.
performance.loops: Bounded original 3x3x3 cell loops, four spatial taps, nine mineral response taps; no generated giant constant inlining, renderer, texture, cache or material atlas.

verification.scope: Source lock, WGSL identifier scan, double reference, scale/bounds, raw-height invariance, geometry-only dependency closure, unchanged maintenance controls, near quadrature limit, statistical response integration and far appearance convergence
verification.naga: Not run in this leaf task; parent owns compiler QA
verification.gpu: Not run in this leaf task; parent owns original-GLSL parity and actual render QA

parentIntegration.visual: Full native host failed SPIR-V ID overflow before capture; correction isolates unchanged mother to typed granite candidate. No visual approval.

fixturePlan.originalGLSL: Compile exact scell + stoneFields extract with sKind=2, sSurface=(1,.7,sourceWet,roughBias), sDisplay.w=1,sRelief=1,uEventCount=0 and original seeds. Send pos=pLocalM/.026; multiply returned original height by .026.
fixturePlan.pointChecks: Actual GPU compare linear RGB, roughness and height for mixed signs, source cell boundaries, wet/bias states; compare WGSL kpGraniteHeight and kpGraniteOriginalSurface height.
fixturePlan.bridgeChecks: At footprint 0, compare kpGraniteSurface against source point with resolveStoneFabric uniforms. Across positive footprints, height must be unchanged; far albedo/roughness should converge without salt-pepper cells.
fixturePlan.integrationChecks: Same locked window, brick B, camera and lighting; id2 tower granite only. Inspect actual physical normals, silhouette/march behavior, measured on-screen footprint and old id13/other-material controls.

license.changes: New WGSL syntax for existing kind2, authored metre bridge, separate source-response footprint filter, inherited maintenance bridge and test-only reference
